description: Reveal who is selling or letting a listing: the portal or agency it is advertised on, the agent, the ad reference and the link to the original ad, plus the ad's own text. Spends one reveal from the person's Every Room plan (Search US$9.99 a week (5 sellers), Pro US$21.99 a week (20 sellers)), or their one free reveal; a listing already revealed costs nothing. Ask the person before spending one. Without reveals left it returns revealed: false with an upgrade_url for the person to open. Needs sign-in.
name: reveal_seller
title: Reveal the seller
